paragraphs: Flotek strives to be the collaborative partner of choice for solutions that reduce the environmental impact of energy on air, water, land and people. An advanced technology-driven, chemical and data analytics company, Flotek seeks to provide unique and innovative solutions to its customers in both the domestic and international energy markets. The Company is committed to delivering products and services that endeavor to maximize customer returns by leveraging chemistry as the common value creation platform.

The Company's Chemistry Technologies ("CT") segment designs, develops, manufactures, packages, distributes and markets optimized chemistry solutions that we believe help customers improve their return on invested capital, lower operational costs and realize tangible environmental benefits aimed at enhancing the profitability of hydrocarbon producers.

The Company's Data Analytics ("DA") segment provides analytical measurement and digital solutions, including measure-and-control services, that deliver near real-time insights for process control across the oil and gas value chain and emerging applications in power and digital valuation. DA solutions help customers optimize performance, improve decision-making, and reduce emissions and carbon intensity.

The Company was initially incorporated under the laws of the Province of British Columbia in 1985. In October 2001, the Company changed its corporate domicile to the State of Delaware. In December 2007, the Company's common stock began trading on the New York Stock Exchange ("NYSE") under the stock ticker symbol "FTK."

As used herein, "Flotek," the "Company," "we," "our" and "us" refers to Flotek Industries, Inc. and/or the Company's wholly-owned subsidiaries. The use of these terms is not intended to connote any particular corporate status or relationship.

The Company entered into a series of transactions in connection with an Asset Purchase Agreement, dated as of April 28, 2025 (the "Purchase Agreement"), with ProFrac GDM, LLC ("ProFrac GDM"), an indirect subsidiary of ProFrac Holding Corp. ("ProFrac"), and various subsidiaries of ProFrac, pursuant to which, among other things, the Company acquired certain mobile power generation assets, comprised of twenty-two operating units and eight units under construction, certain inventory and related intellectual property (the "Acquired Assets"). Concurrently, the Leased Equipment (as defined below) was leased back to ProFrac GDM pursuant to an Agreement for Equipment Rental, dated as of April 28, 2025, by and between PWRtek, LLC ("PWRtek"), a wholly-owned subsidiary of the Company, and ProFrac GDM (the "Lease Agreement") (collectively, the "PWRtek Transactions"). As of December 31, 2025, the eight units under construction have been completed and placed into service.

Total consideration paid by the Company in connection with the PWRtek Transactions was $107.5 million, which consisted of the following: (1) an offset of $17.6 million against the Company's accrued and 2024 Contract Shortfall Fee (defined below), which was the consideration for the acquisition of the Acquired Assets, (2) a warrant (the "April 2025 Warrant") to purchase 6,000,000 shares of the Company's common stock, (3) a secured promissory note, issued by PWRtek in the initial principal amount of $40 million (the "PWRtek Note"), and (4) a $7.2 million offset against the 2025 Contract Shortfall Fee (the "OSP Offset") amount due under the ProFrac Agreement (as defined below). For additional information, see "Part II, Item 8. Financial Statements and Supplementary Data - Note 3 - Asset Acquisition."

On November 7, 2025, the Company entered into a series of agreements with ProFrac GDM, in connection with the assignment of the PWRtek Note to PC Energy Credit I LLC, an affiliate of the founders and principal stockholders of ProFrac and entities owned by or affiliated with them and a related party to ProFrac (the "Note Assignment").

In connection with the Note Assignment, (1) the Company and ProFrac GDM entered into that certain Consent, Acknowledgement and Amendment to Senior Secured Note Documents, dated as of November 7, 2025 (the "Assignment Consent"), (2) ProFrac and ProFrac GDM entered into that certain Guaranty, dated as of November 7, 2025 (the "ProFrac Parent Guaranty"), and (3) the Company and ProFrac GDM entered into that certain Amendment No. 1 to Agreement for Equipment Rental, dated as of November 7, 2025 (the "Lease Amendment," and together with the Assignment Consent and the ProFrac Parent Guaranty, the "Transaction Documents").

Pursuant to the Transaction Documents, in consideration for the Company's consent to the Note Assignment, the parties involved agreed to various amendments which include, among other things, (a) the provision of a guaranty by ProFrac of all of ProFrac GDM's obligations under the Lease Agreement, (b) the elimination of all make-whole amounts and prepayment premiums applicable to the PWRtek Note, providing the Company with the unrestricted ability to prepay the PWRtek Note without premiums or penalties, (c) the removal of a "Material Adverse Effect" event of default under the PWRtek Note relating

to the Company, and (d) the removal of restrictions included in the PWRtek Note on PWRtek's ability to make distributions (as well as the corresponding removal of restrictions included in the Lease Agreement on ProFrac GDM's ability to make distributions). In addition, in order to facilitate the Note Assignment, the parties further agreed to the removal of the mutual rights to offset Contract Shortfall Fees that are payable under the ProFrac Agreement and the Company's right to offset amounts due pursuant to the Lease Agreement against the principal of the PWRtek Note. As a result, the full principal amount of the PWRtek Note will be payable in cash by the Company, rather than via offset against amounts payable pursuant to the Company's other agreements with ProFrac and its affiliates.

The Company incurred $4.4 million of asset acquisition expenses for the PWRtek Transactions. These costs are primarily comprised of professional services including legal, accounting, and other professional or consulting fees.

On March 3, 2026, the Company announced that it had been awarded its first contract to deliver power services for utilities infrastructure support. Under the agreement, the Company expects to coordinate the installation of up to 50 megawatts ("MW") of power generation equipment including the Company's gas distribution and conditioning assets to support critical federal disaster recovery initiatives. The initial term of the agreement is for six-months, with customer option to extend to four years. The Company expects to begin deploying equipment during the second quarter of 2026.

On March 12, 2026, the Company and ProFrac entered into an agreement (as amended, the "OSP Agreement") regarding the settlement of 2025 Contract Shortfall Fees payable to the Company under the ProFrac Agreement for the measurement period of January 1, 2025 to December 31, 2025. The OSP Agreement provides for the payment of an aggregate of $19.7 million (which amount represents $27.4 million of 2025 Contract Shortfall Fees, net of the OSP Offset and other minor adjustments) of consideration to the Company as follows: $7.2 million to be paid in cash and $12.5 million to be satisfied through an equipment construction and rental credit (the "Equipment Credit"). Under the OSP Agreement, the Company has committed to purchase and/or rent $12.5 million of equipment from ProFrac to be used for opportunities within the Data Analytics segment, with the costs of such equipment to be offset by the Equipment Credit. The Company expects to utilize the Equipment Credit during 2026, however any unused amounts at the end of 2026 would be available for use in 2027 until the full credit is utilized.

paragraphs: The Company's business, financial condition, results of operations, cash flows, liquidity and prospects are subject to various risks and uncertainties. Readers of this Annual Report should not consider any descriptions of these risk factors to be a complete set of all potential risks that could affect the Company. In addition, references to past events are provided by way of example only and are not intended to be a complete listing or a representation as to whether or not such factors have occurred in the past or their likelihood of occurring in the future. These factors should be carefully considered together with the other information contained in this Annual Report and the other reports and materials filed by the Company with the SEC. Further, many of these risks are interrelated and, as a result, the occurrence of certain risks could trigger and/or exacerbate other risks. Such a combination could materially increase the severity of the impact of these risks on the Company's business, results of operations, financial condition, cash flows, liquidity or prospects.

This Annual Report contains "forward-looking statements," as defined in Section 27A of the Securities Act and Section 21E of the Exchange Act that involve risks and uncertainties. Forward-looking statements discuss Company prospects, expected revenue, expenses and profits, strategic and operational initiatives, and other activities. Forward-looking statements also contain suppositions regarding future oil and natural gas industry and other conditions, both domestically and internationally. The Company's results could differ materially from those anticipated in the forward-looking statements as a result of a variety of factors, including risks described below and elsewhere. See "Forward-Looking Statements" at the beginning of this Annual Report.

•The Company's business is largely dependent upon its customers' spending in the oil and gas industry. Spending could be adversely affected by industry conditions; new or increased governmental regulations; changes to existing governmental regulations; global economic conditions; the availability of credit; and oil and natural gas prices;
•The Company's reliance on the ProFrac Agreement and Lease Agreement, both with affiliates of ProFrac, could adversely impact our financial condition, results of operations and cash flows;

•The Company's inability to develop and/or introduce new products or differentiate existing products could have an adverse effect on its ability to be responsive to customers' needs and could result in a loss of customers, as well as adversely affecting the Company's future success and profitability;

paragraphs: Flotek 希望成為提供解決方案的首選合作夥伴，以減少能源對空氣、水、土地及人們的環境影響。Flotek 是一家以先進科技驅動的化學與數據分析公司，致力於為國內外能源市場的客戶提供獨特且創新性的解決方案。本公司致力於提供產品與服務，以透過化學作為共同價值創造平台，來最大化客戶回報。
本公司的化學技術（"CT"）應報告分部設計、開發、製造、包裝、分銷與行銷優化化的化學解決方案，本公司相信這些解決方案有助於客戶提高其投資回報率、降低運營成本，並實現可見的環境效益，以提升石化產品生產者的利潤率。
本公司的數據分析（"DA"）應報告分部提供分析測量與數位解決方案，包括測量與控制服務，以在油氣價值鏈及電力與數位評估等新興應用中，提供近乎即時的洞察，用以控制流程。DA 解決方案協助客戶優化表現、改善決策，並減少排放與碳強度。
本公司最初於1985年根據不列顛哥倫比亞省法律註冊成立。2001年10月，本公司將公司註冊地改為美國特拉華州。2007年12月，本公司普通股開始在紐約證券交易所（"NYSE"）交易，股票代碼為"FTK."
herein 所述的 "Flotek"、"本公司"、"我們"、"我們的"及 "我們" 指的是 Flotek Industries, Inc. 及/或本公司的 wholly-owned 子公司。使用這些詞彙並非意圖表示任何特定的公司地位或關係。

本公司已進行一系列交易，根據2025年4月28日簽訂的資產買賣協議（"買賣協議"），與 ProFrac GDM, LLC（"ProFrac GDM"），為 ProFrac Holding Corp.（"ProFrac"）的間接子公司，以及 ProFrac 的各子公司，根據協議，本公司取得某些移動電力生成資產，包括二十個運作中的單位與八個正在建設中的單位，某些存貨及相關智慧財產權（"取得資產"）。同時，根據2025年4月28日簽訂的設備租賃協議，由 PWRtek, LLC（"PWRtek"），為本公司 wholly-owned 子公司，與 ProFrac GDM 約定，將租賃設備（如後文所定義）租回給 ProFrac GDM（"租賃協議"）（ collectively，"PWRtek 交易"）。截至2025年12月31日，八個正在建設中的單位已完成並投入運作。

本公司在 PWRtek 交易中支付的總對價為 107.5 百萬美元，其組成如下：(1) 17.6 百萬美元抵銷本公司應計及 2024 合約短額費用（如後文所定義），作為取得資產的對價；(2) 一張認購權證（"2025 年 4 月權證"），可購買本公司 6,000,000 股普通股；(3) 一張由 PWRtek 發行的有擔保貸款協議，初始本金為 40 百萬美元（"PWRtek 貸款"）；(4) 7.2 百萬美元抵銷 2025 年合約短額費用（"OSP 抵銷"）金額，根據 ProFrac 協議（如後文所定義）應支付。如需更多資訊，請參閱 "第二部分，第 8 項。財務報表與補充資料 - 第 3 項 - 資產取得。"
2025 年 11 月 7 日，本公司與 ProFrac GDM 簽訂一系列協議，與 PWRtek 貸款的轉讓給 PC Energy Credit I LLC（"PC Energy Credit I LLC"），為 ProFrac 的創始人及主要股東之附屬公司及由其擁有或相關之實體，以及 ProFrac 的相關方（"貸款轉讓"）有關。

關於此筆貸款轉讓，(1) 本公司與 ProFrac GDM 簽訂了 dated as of November 7, 2025 的 Consent, Acknowledgement and Amendment to Senior Secured Note Documents（稱為 "貸款轉讓同意書"），(2) ProFrac 與 ProFrac GDM 簽訂了 dated as of November 7, 2025 的 Guaranty（稱為 "ProFrac 父公司擔保"），以及 (3) 本公司與 ProFrac GDM 簽訂了 dated as of November 7, 2025 的 Amendment No. 1 to Agreement for Equipment Rental（稱為 "租賃協議修正案"，與貸款轉讓同意書及 ProFrac 父公司擔保合稱為 "交易文件"）。

根據交易文件，為換取本公司對貸款轉讓的同意，相關當事人同意進行多項修正，包括但不限於 (a) ProFrac 對 ProFrac GDM 在租賃協議下的義務提供擔保，(b) 消除所有與 PWRtek 貸款相關的 make-whole 金額及預付款 premium，使本公司得以無 premium 或罰款預付款 PWRtek 貸款，(c) 移除與 PWRtek 貸款相關的 "重大不利影響" 事件，以及 (d) 移除 PWRtek 貸款中對 PWRtek 進行分紅的限制（同時也移除租賃協議中對 ProFrac GDM 進行分紅的限制）。此外，為促進貸款轉讓，相關當事人進一步同意移除 ProFrac 協議下雙方對合約虧損費用的相互抵銷權利，以及本公司對租賃協議下應付款項對 PWRtek 貸款本金的抵銷權利。因此，PWRtek 貸款的全部本金將由本公司以現金支付，而非透過抵銷本公司與 ProFrac 及其關係企業的其他協議下應付款項。
因此，PWRtek 貸款的全部本金將由本公司以現金支付，而非透過抵銷本公司與 ProFrac 及其關係企業的其他協議下應付款項。
本公司於 PWRtek 交易中支出了 4.4 百萬美元的資產取得費用。這些費用主要為專業服務費用，包括法律、會計及其他專業或諮詢費用。
於 2026 年 3 月 3 日，本公司宣佈已獲得第一份合約，用以提供電力服務支援電力基礎設施。根據協議，本公司預期會協調安裝最高達 50 兆瓦（"MW"）的電力發電設備，包括本公司之天然氣分配及調節資產，以支援關鍵的聯邦災難復原計畫。該協議的初始期限為六個月，客戶可選擇延長至四年。本公司預期於 2026 年第二季開始部署設備。

於 2026 年 3 月 12 日，本公司與 ProFrac 籤訂協議（經修正後，稱為 "OSP 協議"），關於結算 2025 年合約短欠費用，該費用為本公司根據 ProFrac 協議於 2025 年 1 月 1 日至 2025 年 12 月 31 日測量期間應收取的金額。OSP 協議規定，本公司將收到總計 19.7 百萬美元（該金額代表 2025 年合約短欠費用 27.4 百萬美元，扣除 OSP 抵銷及其他小額調整後的金額）作為對價，如下：7.2 百萬美元以現金支付，12.5 百萬美元則透過設備建設及租賃信用（稱為 "設備信用"）抵銷。根據 OSP 協議，本公司承諾自 ProFrac 購買及租賃總計 12.5 百萬美元的設備，用於 Data Analytics 分部的機會，該設備的費用將由設備信用抵銷。本公司預期於 2026 年使用設備信用，然而 2026 年末未使用的金額將可於 2027 年使用，直至設備信用完全使用為止。

headings: 與本公司業務相關的風險
與本公司產業相關的風險
與本公司證券相關的風險
本公司對 ProFrac 合約及租賃合約（皆與 ProFrac 關係企業簽訂）的依賴，可能對本公司財務狀況、營運成果及現金流產生不利影響。
若無法取得足夠資金，將可能對本公司業務、財務狀況、營運成果及成長與競爭能力產生不利影響。
競爭增加可能對本公司產品及服務的售價造成向下壓力。
失去關鍵客戶可能對本公司營運結果產生不利影響，並可能導致本公司營業收入減少。
美國貿易政策的變化及關稅的影響，可能對本公司業務及營運結果產生重大不利影響。
未能向關鍵客戶收取已售商品及服務的款項，可能對本公司財務結果、流動性及現金流產生不利影響。
網路攻擊可能對本公司營運及相關財務狀況產生重大且不利的影響。
本公司業務受複雜且不斷演進的資料隱私權及網路安全相關法律法規所規範。
未預見的或有事項，如訴訟，可能對本公司財務狀況產生不利影響。
本公司現行的保險政策可能無法充分保護本公司業務免於所有潛在風險。
若本公司未能成功管理擴張所可能面臨的困難，將可能對本公司營運成果造成不利影響。
本公司可能進行戰略收購、合資企業及戰略資產處置，這可能會對本公司業務產生不利影響。
由於2023年發生了"股權變更"，本公司使用淨營業虧損及稅務屬性結轉以抵銷未來應稅所得的能力受到限制。
本公司與本公司客戶均面臨在美國境外從事業務的風險，包括政治風險、外匯風險及其他不確定因素。
若本公司未能維持適當且有效的財務報導內部控製，將可能影響本公司產生準確且及時財務報表的能力。
與水力壓裂相關的法律及法規變更可能對本公司營運產生負面影響。
本公司所屬產業員工流動率高，難以吸引或留住人員或代理商可能對本公司業務產生不利影響。
本公司DA分部可能因政府法規而受到負面影響。
paragraphs: 本公司之業務、財務狀況、營運成果、現金流、流動性及前景均受各種風險與不確定性所影響。本年度報告之讀者不得認為對這些風險因素之描述為完整列出所有可能影響本公司之潛在風險。此外，對過去事件之參考僅為範例，並非完整清單，亦不表示這些因素是否曾於過去發生或未來發生之可能性。這些因素應與本年度報告及其他資訊，以及本公司向證券交易委員會（SEC）所提交之其他報告與資料一併仔細考量。進一步而言，許多這些風險彼此相關，因此某些風險之發生可能觸發並/或加劇其他風險。如此組合可能大幅增加這些風險對本公司業務、營運成果、財務狀況、現金流、流動性或前景之影響程度。
本年度報告包含所謂「向前看聲明」，如證券交易法第27A條及證券交易所法第21E條所定義。向前看聲明討論本公司前景、預期營業收入、費用與利潤、戰略與營運計畫及其他活動。向前看聲明亦包含對未來石油與天然氣產業及其他條件之假設，包括國內與國際情況。本公司之結果可能與向前看聲明所預期者有重大差異，原因可能為多種因素，包括下列所描述之風險及其他處所。請參閱本年度報告開頭之「向前看聲明」。
•本公司之業務 largely 依賴客戶於石油與天然氣產業之支出。支出可能因產業狀況；新或增加之政府規範；現有政府規範之變更；全球經濟狀況；信貸之可得性；以及石油與天然氣價格而受到不利影響；
•本公司對 ProFrac 合約與租賃合約之依賴，皆與 ProFrac 之關係企業簽訂，可能對本公司之財務狀況、營運成果及現金流造成不利影響；
•本公司無法開發與/或推出新產品或使現有產品差異化，可能對其應對客戶需求之能力造成不利影響，並可能導致客戶流失，同時對本公司未來之成功與獲利造成不利影響；
•本公司之業務、財務狀況、營運成果及成長與競爭能力，可能因無法取得足夠資金而受到不利影響；
